name: Account Move Recycle Bin
description: account move recycle bin  provides a secure way to manage deleted Account Move records in Odoo without losing them permanently. Deleted records are automatically stored in the Recycle Bin, allowing administrators to review and manage them when needed. Required Account Move records can be restored directly from the Recycle Bin whenever recovery is necessary. A dedicated restore option makes it easy to bring important deleted records back into the system. Administrators can configure default retention days from the settings to control how long deleted records remain in the Recycle Bin. Once the selected retention period is reached, stored Recycle Bin records are automatically deleted permanently.
summary: Account Move Recycle Bin  provides a reliable solution for managing deleted Account Move records in Odoo. Deleted records are securely moved to the Recycle Bin instead of being removed permanently, helping prevent accidental data loss. Administrators can easily review stored records and restore required Account Move records whenever needed. The restore functionality brings selected deleted records back into the system efficiently. A configurable default retention period allows administrators to define how long deleted records should remain in the Recycle Bin. After the selected retention period expires, deleted records are automatically removed permanently, helping maintain clean and organized accounting data.

name: Recycle Bin Base
description: Recycle Bin Base provides a centralized solution for securely managing deleted records across Odoo business applications. Deleted records from supported modules such as Sale Order, Purchase Order, Inventory, Invoice, and other related applications can be stored safely in the Recycle Bin instead of being permanently removed. Administrators can review deleted records and restore required records directly from the Recycle Bin whenever needed. Restored records are also organized in the Restore Records menu, making recovery activities easy to track and manage. A configurable default retention period allows deleted records to be automatically removed permanently after the specified number of days. This helps maintain clean data while providing a reliable recovery mechanism for accidentally or unnecessarily deleted records.
summary: Recycle Bin Base provides a secure and reliable way to manage deleted records across Odoo applications. Deleted records from Sale Order, Purchase Order, Inventory, Invoice, and other supported modules can be safely stored in the Recycle Bin. Administrators can review deleted records and restore important records whenever required. Restored records are organized in the Restore Records menu for easy tracking and management. A configurable default retention period automatically removes deleted records permanently after the specified number of days. This app helps prevent accidental data loss while keeping deleted and restored records organized, controlled, and easy to manage.

name: Maintenance Request Recycle Bin
description: Maintenance Request Recycle Bin provides a secure and reliable way to manage deleted Maintenance Request records in Odoo. Deleted maintenance requests are moved to the Recycle Bin instead of being permanently removed, helping prevent accidental data loss. Users can access the Recycle Bin to review deleted maintenance request records and restore the required records whenever needed. The app includes a configurable Default Retention Days setting to control how long deleted maintenance requests remain stored. Once the selected retention period is reached, expired Recycle Bin records are automatically deleted permanently. This makes it easier to recover deleted maintenance requests while keeping the database clean and organized.
